column1: What JavaScript method prevents new properties from being added to an object and marks all existing properties as read-only and non-configurable?
Why is Object.freeze() considered shallow by default in JavaScript?
column2: It only freezes direct properties of the top-level object; nested child objects and arrays remain fully mutable unless frozen recursively.

column1: What JavaScript predicate function checks whether an object has been frozen?
What is the primary security vulnerability when injecting dynamic string variables directly into element.innerHTML?
column2: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), where unescaped user or data strings can execute malicious JavaScript in the victim's browser.

column1: What five fundamental characters must an HTML sanitization function encode to prevent XSS injection in markup?
column2: Ampersand (&), less-than (<), greater-than (>), double quote ("), and single quote (').

What modern CSS property allows a container to automatically maintain proportional width and height before media loads?
How does CSS aspect-ratio prevent Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) during page loading?
column2: It instructs the layout engine to reserve the exact vertical box dimensions immediately during the Layout phase before images download.

column1: In CSS Grid, what is the effect of repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr)) on a 1000px wide container?
column2: It creates 3 equal columns of ~333px each, automatically stretching items to fill the row.

column1: What is the key behavioral difference between auto-fit and auto-fill in CSS Grid when there are fewer items than available tracks?
column2: auto-fit collapses empty remaining tracks to 0px allowing items to stretch, whereas auto-fill preserves empty tracks as empty space.

column1: What browser lifecycle event fires as soon as the HTML document has been completely parsed and the DOM tree is built, without waiting for stylesheets or images?
What browser lifecycle event waits for the entire page, including all dependent resources such as images, stylesheets, and iframes, to finish loading?
In a flexbox column (.portfolio-card), what CSS rule forces a terminal button to align to the bottom edge across cards of varying text height?
column2: margin-top: auto; (on the footer or CTA button inside a display: flex; flex-direction: column container)

column1: What is the WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast ratio requirement for standard body text against its background?
column2: 4.5:1 (or 3:1 for large text >= 24px regular or >= 18.66px bold)

column1: What is the minimum recommended touch-target size according to mobile web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1)?
What CSS media query allows websites to detect if a user has requested the operating system to minimize non-essential motion or animations?
What is the purpose of the WAI-ARIA role="tablist" attribute on a container?
column2: It identifies the container to screen readers as a group of tab controls that organize content into selectable views.

column1: What WAI-ARIA attribute communicates to assistive technology whether an individual tab is currently selected or inactive?
In JavaScript, what built-in function properly encodes special characters including commas, slashes, and ampersands for use inside a URL query string parameter?
How does encodeURIComponent() differ from encodeURI()?
column2: encodeURIComponent() encodes URI syntax separators like &, ?, =, /, whereas encodeURI() leaves protocol and domain structural characters intact.

column1: Why should you check typeof document !== 'undefined' before attaching event listeners in universal JavaScript code?
column2: To prevent ReferenceError exceptions when the script is imported or executed in server-side, Node.js, or headless test runner environments where document does not exist.
